data.title: Jean Marie Cullon gave Lulu and Georgia 3 stars. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

## [Slightly disappointing](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/69ed254b406358db9d43fcda)

I have ordered twice from this company. First time there was an extended delay in receiving the products and I kept initiating the communication. They really should have done that. They apologized and reimbursed shipping without request so that's more than expected

This second time my order was received damaged and it was my full order although they said one item would be shipped at a later date. They responded immediately to my concern and I in turn sent immediate request of picture and later that it was the larger container that had broken because I was to receive only the smaller container from there shipping invoice. Now I have heard nothing. Maybe they are on vacation which is fine but t then don't say "you wish to expedite sending new product" when there is no turn around within a 24 hour business day.

April 20, 2026

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Apr 27, 2026

Hi Jean,

Thank you for your feedback! We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the delays and the damage to your order. Our Customer Support team has issued a credit for your shipping fees, and we are currently processing a replacement canister for the damaged item. We will send you the tracking information as soon as it becomes available. Thank you for your patience, and please let us know if you have any further questions. We are happy to help!

Lulu and Georgia
